# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_EXPANSION_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Midday EMA-ribbon expansion (>20% from 5-period minimum) combined with a break of structure (higher high on strong volume ≥1.5× 20-period average) and close above VWAP signals a continuation move between 11:00-13:00 ET. This captures intraday momentum during steady trends while avoiding first/last 30 minutes and major news. The ribbon expansion filter adds robustness to pure higher-high triggers by confirming increasing volatility alignment with price breakout.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Between 11:00 and 13:00 ET, if:
- Ribbon width (Slow EMA - Fast EMA on 3-min chart) expands >20% from its 5-period minimum
- Price makes a new higher high (HH) on volume ≥1.5× the 20-period average volume
- Close above VWAP
Then enter long at the bar’s close.

**Exit:**
- Initial stop: chart-stop at prior swing low (most recent higher low)
- TP1: 2× risk (distance from entry to stop)
- Runner: trail 20% off highest-watermark after TP1 hit
- Time stop: 13:30 ET (if not exited earlier)
